item.title: Trump administration announces global economic war on Iran
item.description: This is a breaking news story.

item.title: Israeli strike on Gaza shelter extends casualty list
item.description: More than 1,200 Palestinians have been killed since the October 2025 ceasefire agreement.

item.title: What to expect as Iran braces for new US economic measures amid war
item.description: Tehran may count on links with China and others to weather the storm, but average Iranian people will bear the brunt.

item.title: UK to help Ukraine build Storm Shadow long-range missiles: Why it matters
item.description: The UK's willingness to share classified missile-production knowledge sets a potentially important precedent.

item.title: Samuel Eto’o urges support for embattled FIFA President Gianni Infantino
item.description: Former star striker, now head of Cameroon's FA, backs Infantino despite mounting pressure on him to resign.

item.title: Four arrested over fatal shooting of South African boxer Zolani Tete
item.description: Tete, who won world WBF flyweight and WBO bantamweight titles, was killed outside his home in Eastern Cape last week.

item.title: South Korea says US cancelled upcoming joint marine exercises over Iran war
item.description: The cancellation follows Trump's surprise order last week to scale back a separate annual joint military drill.

item.title: Iran faces 'greatest financial offensive ever', says US treasury secretary
item.description: Scott Bessent says the US will sever all economic ties with the country and that any nation partnering with Iran financially will also be isolated.

item.title: Israel warns of 'forceful' response to kites flown from Gaza
item.description: Hamas says the kites found in Israeli border communities in recent days were launched by children in Gaza.

item.title: Four arrested over suspected poisoning of elephants in Kenya
item.description: An investigation is looking into whether the deaths were caused by pesticides sprayed on tomato crops.
